name: Should I choose a pre-hung or slab door for replacement?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a pre-hung or slab door for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a pre-hung or slab door depends on your existing frame's condition and the installation. A pre-hung door comes with the frame, hinges, and bore holes already assembled, making installation easier and ensuring a good fit, especially if your current frame is damaged or misaligned. A slab door is just the door itself, requiring an existing frame in good condition. Slab doors are generally less expensive but require more labor to hang and fit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a pre-hung door if your frame is damaged or for easier installation; choose a slab door if your existing frame is in good condition.
